content: Mɔ̈ɔ̈ a duu anà Nzam
Abà, bitwey ba bàbalàbal u mbwo a làkwikilà, bi ibà a duu anà Nzam u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Amu nde, bi kan'wal mbwo u làkwikilà, unsà kab a ngway alà ifàkal bi aŋàtsim uboo a la anà ifàswaŋ bi ngaal unsà làkyän a làkoo a Nzam.
Yumwɛy, bi ifàswaŋ ngaal itàkal uboo a ngyɛb aŋàdiir, bi ikyàyöb naa ngyɛb aŋàdiir ifàbɔr muküünà,
muküünà afàpà ntsim uboo a nsii, ntsim uboo a nsii ifàbɔr làkyän.
Kyekà, làkyän làfàkur anki, ntɔn ukwen a Nzam bàŋàyɔl u mpem abi u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl awà bipɛ.
Ntɔn, utaaŋ bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n bi ngwal, Klistɔ kàkü ntɔn baar a man'be, utaaŋ làkwe la.
Yà mpay naa mbuur ukü ntɔn mbuur a balàbal, taaŋ lumwɛy, yan'kwo ikäl naa mbuur mwɛy ukäl anà un'kanà mukyey ukwà ntɔn mbuur aŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ Nzam afàswaŋ ukwen ande akà bi: Ntɔn, u taaŋ bàkäl bi baar a man'be, Klistɔ kàkü ntɔn bi.
Ntɔn apanà, bi bàkyitwey balàbal u mbwo a an'kil nde, abun, bi sye isàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u nkyɛl.
Kyakin, isàkal naa bi bàkäl ayiiŋ a Nzam, bi bàkyàbulà un'tüüb anà nde u mbwo a nkweel a Mwan ande, awà bi unsà un'tüüb, bi ikyer asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.
Kà nà abwɛy mpɛl anki, bi bàfàswaŋ ngaal amu Nzam u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ, u mbwo ande apanà, bi bàwɛl lɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Adam anà Klistɔ
Kyakin, asànaa u mbwo a mbuur mwɛy man'be màbilà u mɛɛn manswà, waa ube bàtwääl ukwà, waa ukwà bàbilà mbuur wanswà ntɔn baar banswà bàkyer man'be.
Ntɔn, fà nsɛmà tii un'kɔɔn, man'be màkäl u mɛɛn. Wɛɛ, ntaaŋàmbar yàkäl anki ntɔn man'be, un'kɔɔn kàkäl anki.
Kyekà, fà Adam tii akà Mɔsɛ, ukwà bàkyer akal, itàkal akà baar mpa bàkyer man'be, akɔ̈ɔ̈n ngweem asànaa mà Adam, ifà a mbuur awà ayàyà.

Wɛɛ, ye anà nsöön uboo a kab a ngway anà ibii. Ntɔn, isàkal naa u mbwo a man'be a mbuur mwɛy, bàmbɔɔn bàkyen ukwà, lalan sye, u mbwo a kab a ngway a Nzam, kab a ngway lan'fà akà mbuur mwɛy, Yɛsu Klistɔ, lan'söön ntɔn baar mbɔɔn.
Yumwɛy, kab a Nzam lan'lyaaŋ man'be a mbuur mwɛy u mfun: abà, u mbwo a man'be a mbuur mwɛy, ntsüül a nsaŋ yan'pà ntaaŋàmbar, kyekà, kab a ngway bàpɛ ungö a ibii mbɔɔn, lan'lwom ntaaŋàmbar.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa u mbwo a ibii a mbuur mwɛy, ukwà bàkyer ayaal, abun sye, u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ mpɛl, baar bàfàwal kab a ngway mbɔɔn anà kab a balàbal, bàsàyaal u mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Abun, ntɔn ibii a mbuur mwɛy, mbuur wanswà kàwɛl ntaaŋàmbar, abun sye, isal a balàbal a mbuur mwɛy, kyà ntɔn baar banswà bàwɛl balàbal làfàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Abun sye, unsà ukɔɔn ngweem a mbuur mwɛy, baar mbɔɔn bàbulà baar a man'be, ifà imwɛy sye, unsà unkyeey a mbuur mwɛy, un'kàbɔ bàbulà bàbalàbal.
Kyeka, un'kɔɔn kan'yà ntɔn ibii ibɛy, wɛɛ, kà ikal man'bilà man'be mbɔɔn, kab a ngway lan'sɔ̈ɔ̈nà.
Kyakin, asànaa man'be man'yaal ntɔn ukwà, apan u mbwo a balàbal, kab a ngway làyaal ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ, Mwol abi.
